subject.title: fix(hooks): bound hook workspace manifest and HOOK.md reads

question: When a previously loadable workspace hook exceeds the new 1 MiB metadata limit, should discovery warn and skip, silently skip, or fail the workspace hook scan?
rationale: The bound is technically justified, but the user-visible upgrade behavior and diagnostic policy are compatibility choices that cannot be inferred safely from the helper refactor.

options.title: Warn and skip
options.body: Reject the oversized hook entry while emitting one actionable warning that identifies the metadata file and 1 MiB limit.

options.title: Silently skip
options.body: Keep discovery’s existing invalid-entry behavior and omit user-visible diagnostics for oversized metadata.

options.title: Fail discovery
options.body: Surface oversized metadata as a scan error, making the problem explicit but potentially blocking other valid workspace hooks.

recommendation.title: Warn and skip
recommendation.body: Reject the oversized hook entry while emitting one actionable warning that identifies the metadata file and 1 MiB limit.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the best available core hooks owner for setting upgrade and diagnostic policy across discovery paths.
